en: This tunnel goes a long way, kid!
Watch for ONIX.\nThey appear only occasionally.\pHigh-level ones can put the\nsqueeze on you!
Ease up!\nWhat am I doing?\lWhich way is out?
That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12\nforced me to take this detour.
Outsiders like you need to show me\nsome respect!
Oh well, I'll get a ZUBAT as I go!
Eek!\pDon't try anything funny in the\ndark!
I saw a MACHOP in this tunnel.
I came this far looking for wild\nPOKéMON.
You looked cute and harmless.\nWas I ever wrong!
